class.name: com.simplysoftware.EasyModbusClient.EasyModbusClient
class.comment: EasyModbusClient - TCP implementation for B4X applications. This library provides Modbus TCP communication with support for 16-bit and 32-bit data.
class.event: MultipleCoilsWritten (StartingAddress As Int, Values() As Boolean)
MultipleRegistersWritten (StartingAddress As Int, Values() As Int)
Connected (Message As String, Connected As Boolean)
ConnectionCheckDone(IsLive As Boolean, Message As String)
TestCompleted(Success As Boolean, Message As String)
DiagnosticRequest(SubFunction As Int, Data As Int)
WriteResult(Success As Boolean, Message As String)

method.name: ReadHoldingRegisters
method.comment: Reads holding registers as unsigned 16-bit values (Function Code 3). StartingAddress The 0-based starting register address. Quantity Number of registers to read. Return an array of unsigned 16-bit integers. Results are also raised asynchronously in the HoldingRegistersReceived event.

method.name: TestFunction
method.comment: Executes a self-test based on the configured TestFunction and TestAddress. Results are returned asynchronously in the TestCompleted and ConnectionCheckDone events.

method.name: Connected
method.comment: Indicates whether the Modbus TCP client is currently connected. Return true if connected, otherwise false.

method.name: Connect
method.comment: Connects to a Modbus TCP slave at the specified IP address and port. IpAddress The IP address of the Modbus TCP slave. Port The TCP port of the Modbus TCP slave. TimeoutMs The connection timeout in milliseconds. Raises the Connected event when complete.

method.name: ReadCoils
method.comment: Reads coil values (Function Code 1). StartingAddress The 0-based starting coil address. Quantity Number of coils to read. Return an array of boolean values. Results are also raised asynchronously in the CoilsReceived event.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initialises the EasyModbusClient wrapper for use in B4A/B4J. EventName The event name prefix used for raising events.

method.name: WriteRegister
method.comment: Writes a single holding register (Function Code 6). Offset The 0-based register address. Value The 16-bit value to write. Results are raised asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: Disconnect
method.comment: Closes the connection to the Modbus TCP slave. Always raises the Disconnected event when complete.

method.name: ReadInputRegisters
method.comment: Reads input registers as unsigned 16-bit values (Function Code 4). StartingAddress The 0-based starting register address. Quantity Number of registers to read. Return an array of unsigned 16-bit integers. Results are also raised asynchronously in the InputRegistersReceived event.

method.name: WriteCoil
method.comment: Writes a single coil value (Function Code 5). Offset The 0-based coil address. Value The boolean value to write. Results are raised asynchronously in the WriteResult event.

method.name: ReadWriteMultipleRegisters
method.comment: FC23: Read/Write Multiple Registers. Supports both 16-bit and 32-bit (via register pairing) data types. All register data is treated as unsigned 16-bit integers (0-65535). Read results are returned in HoldingRegistersReceived; write results in WriteResult.

method.name: FloatToRegisters
method.comment: Converts a 32-bit Float into two 16-bit registers (Hi/Lo). Returns an Int array where index 0 is high and index 1 is low.

method.name: WriteRegisters
method.comment: Writes multiple holding registers (Function Code 16). StartingAddress The 0-based starting register address. Values Array of 16-bit values to write. Results are raised asynchronously in the MultipleRegistersWritten event.

method.name: ReadDiscreteInputs
method.comment: Reads discrete input values (Function Code 2). StartingAddress The 0-based starting input address. Quantity Number of inputs to read. Return an array of boolean values. Results are also raised asynchronously in the DiscreteInputsReceived event.

method.name: DiagnosticRequest
method.comment: Diagnostic Request (Function Code 8). SubFunction - The diagnostic sub-function code. Data - The data value to send. This implementation currently handles SubFunction 0 (Loopback/Echo). Raises the DiagnosticRequest event.

method.name: SetTestConfig
method.comment: Configures the test function used by TestFunction(). TestFunction The type of register to read for the test (use TEST_ constants). TestAddress The 0-based address to read for the test.

method.name: WriteCoils
method.comment: Writes multiple coil values (Function Code 15). StartingAddress The 0-based starting coil address. Values Array of boolean values to write. Results are raised asynchronously in the MultipleCoilsWritten event.

method.name: RegistersToFloat
method.comment: Converts two 16-bit registers (Hi/Lo) into a 32-bit Float.

property.name: SlaveID
property.comment: Returns the current Modbus Slave Unit ID. Return the active SlaveID value.

property.name: VerboseLogs
property.comment: Indicates whether verbose logging is currently enabled. Return true if verbose logging is enabled.

field.name: PostReadDelay
field.comment: Property: Sets the post read delay in ms(milliseconds). Set between (50–250) if you are having concurrent read issues. The default value is 0.

field.name: PostWriteDelay
field.comment: Property: Sets the post write delay in ms(milliseconds). Set between (50–250) if you are having concurrent write issues. The default value is 0.
